entries.name: Command Link
entries.rule_summary: Spend 1 AP. One linked ally adds d6 as a VAM die on their next tactical roll before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Motion Economy
entries.rule_summary: Once per turn, Interact with one worn or immediately accessible ordinary item for 0 AP.

entries.name: Breath Control
entries.rule_summary: Extend ordinary breath-holding and remain functional through brief smoke or oxygen stress; extreme exposure still uses the appropriate rule.

entries.name: Thanatic Anchor
entries.rule_summary: With explicit mission authorization and continuous observation, maintain the precision surveillance/insertion lock required for Aletheia's terminal-host implant procedure.

entries.name: Pain Compartmentalization
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene, ignore one temporary injury-related Disadvantage until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Team Clock
entries.rule_summary: Linked allies share precise timing cues. Once per scene, coordinate one simultaneous mundane action without timing uncertainty alone forcing separate setup rolls.

entries.name: Mission Cache
entries.rule_summary: Once per mission, identify one previously authorized ordinary resource, contact method, or cache Aletheia could plausibly have arranged before insertion.

entries.name: Temporal Intuition
entries.rule_summary: Once per mission, ask whether a discovered fact, location, or event has a meaningful relationship to the mission's known temporal fulcrum; the answer is directional, not prescriptive.

entries.name: Coordination Mesh
entries.rule_summary: Once per round when a linked ally succeeds on a setup, Assist, Guard, or tactical coordination action, another linked ally adds d4 as a VAM die to one immediately related roll.

entries.name: Command Mastery Mesh
entries.rule_summary: When coordinating multiple actors under immediate pressure, qualifying rolls with the appropriate Mastered command Skill include its Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Temporal Analysis Mastery
entries.rule_summary: When analyzing an actual continuity anomaly with sufficient evidence, qualifying rolls with the appropriate Mastered Skill include its Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Aletheian Intuition
entries.rule_summary: Once per mission, request one concise encoded directional insight from Aletheia; it identifies a useful relationship or risk but never supplies the correct moral or strategic choice.

entries.name: Distributed Command
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene, spend 1 AP to designate a shared objective. Until your next turn, the first three linked allies taking materially different actions toward it add d4 as a VAM die.

entries.name: Continuance Mesh
entries.rule_summary: During a multi-front continuity crisis, establish up to three simultaneous objectives. Once per round, one qualifying roll toward each distinct objective adds d4 as a VAM die; the Mesh organizes choices but never chooses priorities.
